Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
pallando <pall...@gmx.at> wrote in message
news:9d99ck$2ac$1...@bird.wu-wien.ac.at...
> does brujah debate stack?

Yes.
Also note that you only ever have to tap the one oldest Brujah regardless of
how many Debates you put into play.

> in other words, do all brujah get +x strength and
> x optional maneuvers if there are x brujah debates in play?

Yes.

See the LSJ of [2001-01-08]:

"Each Brujah gets X optional maneuvers from the X Brujah Debates
in play, correct."

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) VTES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/

Also see the clarified online text here:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_B.html#Brujah_Debate

Brujah Debate [DS]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Brujah
Cost: 1 pool
Master. Put this card in play. Each Methuselah with a ready Brujah must
tap [(one of)] the highest capacity Brujah he or she controls during
his or her master phase. Each Brujah gets +1 <strength> and an optional
maneuver each combat. This card may be burned by any minion who is not
Ventrue as a (D) action.

Notice that the card doesn't say the highest capacity Brujah
has to be untapped during your master phase for you to choose
them. If you had a high capacity Brujah tapped from Sensory
Deprivation, for example, you could choose that vampire for each
and every Brujah Debate you managed to put into play. (You could
also choose that same vampire each time even after tapping it for a prior
BD.)

Carpe Noctem.
